sql_queries.sql:
SELECT o.order_no, o.customer_no, o.order_date, o.promised_date, o.status_code,
       c.customer_name,
       a.account_name AS crm_name, a.customer_level, a.owner_id, ow.owner_name,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_shipments s WHERE s.order_no = o.order_no AND s.status IN ('已出库','已签收')) AS shipped_lines
FROM erp_sales_orders o
JOIN erp_customers c ON o.customer_no = c.customer_no
JOIN crm_accounts a ON a.credit_code = c.credit_code AND a.credit_code <> ''
LEFT JOIN crm_owners ow ON a.owner_id = ow.owner_id
WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-10-25' AND '2026-11-23'
  AND a.customer_level IN ('VIP','vip')
  AND o.status_code <> 'X'
  AND o.promised_date < '2026-11-23'
ORDER BY o.order_no;

SELECT o.order_no, o.customer_no, o.order_date, o.promised_date, o.status_code,
       c.customer_name,
       a.account_name AS crm_name, a.customer_level, a.owner_id, ow.owner_name,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_shipments s WHERE s.order_no = o.order_no AND s.status IN ('已出库','已签收')) AS shipped_lines
FROM erp_sales_orders o
JOIN erp_customers c ON o.customer_no = c.customer_no
JOIN crm_accounts a ON a.credit_code = c.credit_code AND a.credit_code <> ''
LEFT JOIN crm_owners ow ON a.owner_id = ow.owner_id
WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-10-25' AND '2026-11-23'
  AND a.customer_level IN ('VIP','vip')
ORDER BY o.order_no;
SELECT MIN(order_date), MAX(order_date) FROM erp_sales_orders;

SELECT o.order_no, o.customer_no, o.order_date, o.promised_date, o.status_code, c.customer_name
FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN erp_customers c ON o.customer_no = c.customer_no
WHERE o.customer_no IN ('C0001','C0003')
ORDER BY o.order_date DESC;
